div.div: شُوبَقٌ A certain wooden implement of the baker, or maker of bread; (K;) a baker's rolling-pin; (MA;) [thus called, and also شُوبَك, in the present day;] an arabicized word, (Ibn-'Abbád, O, K,) from [the Pers.] جُوبَه [or چُوبَهْ, or from the Pers. شُوبَجْ]. (TA.) [See also كَرِيبْ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
